entities.summary: John Adam Barclay is a Scottish former rugby union player, who played as a flanker and number 8. He made 76 international appearances for the Scotland national team 2007–2019, playing at three World Cups. He played club rugby for Glasgow Warriors, Scarlets and Edinburgh Rugby.
